title: Alternative-day ambiguity waits for clarification before lookup
description: The caller starts with an explicit Tuesday-or-Wednesday afternoon preference and confirms it is the first visit. For latency, the assistant may clarify the target day first. After the caller picks Wednesday, it should issue a single fresh checkAvailability call for that Wednesday afternoon instead of spending a first lookup on the ambiguous input.
